tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page ground (MUI background.default). Behind the nav drawer and between sections.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: MUI background.paper: outlined Paper, tables, dialogs, inputs.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Table header rows, code-like blocks, the selected row in a list.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text (MUI text.primary) on bg, surface and surface-sunken: 14.2:1 or more in both themes.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text (MUI text.secondary): dates, helper text, column labels. 6.2:1 or more on bg, surface and surface-sunken in both themes.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Dividers and outlined Paper borders (MUI divider). Decorative only; never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-control
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, outlined buttons and unchecked switches: 3.5:1 or more on bg and surface.

tokens.name: route
tokens.usage: MUI primary.main: contained buttons, active nav item, links, reached stops on the route line, focus ring. 5.4:1 on bg (light), 8.8:1 on surface (dark).

tokens.name: on-route
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a route fill (MUI primary.contrastText): 5.8:1 light, 8.3:1 dark.

tokens.name: route-tint
tokens.usage: Selected nav item, hover on primary rows, soft primary chips. route text on it is 5.0:1 light, 7.0:1 dark.

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: MUI warning.main: follow-up due, needs reconnection, estimates. Text on surface or signal-tint.

tokens.name: signal-tint
tokens.usage: Ground of warning Alerts and follow-up chips; signal text on it is 5.4:1 light, 7.4:1 dark.

tokens.name: stop
tokens.usage: MUI error.main: errors, destructive actions, failed extraction. Never used for the Rejected status.

tokens.name: stop-tint
tokens.usage: Ground of error Alerts; stop text on it is 5.5:1 light, 6.8:1 dark.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px focus-visible outline with 2px offset on every control.

tokens.name: status-applied
tokens.usage: Applied: chip text and route stop. Always paired with the word.

tokens.name: status-applied-tint
tokens.usage: Applied chip ground (6.1:1 light, 7.2:1 dark).

tokens.name: status-screening
tokens.usage: Screening: chip text and route stop.

tokens.name: status-screening-tint
tokens.usage: Screening chip ground (5.8:1 light, 7.6:1 dark).

tokens.name: status-assessment
tokens.usage: Assessment: chip text and route stop.

tokens.name: status-assessment-tint
tokens.usage: Assessment chip ground (5.5:1 light, 8.1:1 dark).

tokens.name: status-interviewing
tokens.usage: Interviewing: the brand line itself.

tokens.name: status-interviewing-tint
tokens.usage: Interviewing chip ground.

tokens.name: status-offer
tokens.usage: Offer: chip text and the route's last stop.

tokens.name: status-offer-tint
tokens.usage: Offer chip ground (6.0:1 light, 8.7:1 dark).

tokens.name: status-accepted
tokens.usage: Accepted: chip text.

tokens.name: status-accepted-tint
tokens.usage: Accepted chip ground (6.7:1 light, 8.2:1 dark).

tokens.name: status-rejected
tokens.usage: Rejected: chip text and branch terminal on the route line.

tokens.name: status-rejected-tint
tokens.usage: Rejected chip ground (6.4:1 light, 7.6:1 dark).

tokens.name: status-closed
tokens.usage: Withdrawn and Abandoned: chip text and branch terminal. Abandoned adds a dashed chip border.

tokens.name: status-closed-tint
tokens.usage: Withdrawn and Abandoned chip ground (5.7:1 light, 7.3:1 dark).

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Counts on the route line and Today's target meters (MUI h3). Tabular figures.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: One page title per screen (MUI h4).

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Section headings inside a page (MUI h6).

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Running text, table cells, timeline entries (MUI body1).
styles.sample: Rejection from Kestrel Pay, matched to Senior Frontend Engineer.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Company names in rows, emphasised values.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons, tabs, chips, form labels (MUI button, subtitle2). Sentence case, never uppercase.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Timestamps, helper text, metadata under a row (MUI caption).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: MUI theme.spacing(1): gap between chips, icon to label, inside dense rows.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: theme.spacing(2): Paper padding, gap between rows of a list, page gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: theme.spacing(3): gap between sections, page gutter on desktop.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: theme.spacing(4): space above a page title, between page header and content.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, inputs, small tags (MUI Chip/OutlinedInput overrides).

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: MUI shape.borderRadius: buttons, outlined Paper, table containers, menus.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs and the bottom sheet on phones.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Only for things that float: menus, popovers, dialogs, snackbars. In-page sections are outlined, never shadowed.
